productPageReviews.reviewDescription: For the price, this laptop gets a 5 star rating. Well, more like 4.5 but I couldn't give it that. It's a good sized laptop with a clear screen. It's pretty darn fast and it looks pretty sharp. Speakers are decent but not mind-blowing and for what it's worth, it has a camera, which is, again, passable, not mind-blowing. The keyboard on the one I got is more of a darker grey (it's advertised as ash grey, which I believe is a lighter color) but I actually like the darker keyboard better. Typing on the keyboard is pretty smooth too. It could use one or two more outlets on the sides though. You only get one USB Type-A port, one USB Type-C port and a headphone jack. Fine if you're more of a minimalist, but not ideal for multi-tasking work. Also, a little tip; When powering on, all you need to do is press the power button, NOT press and hold. I didn't realize that at first and thought initially that their was a problem. Just a piece of advice. Overall, it's a good laptop, at a fair price and should work well for the "Average Joe". I just got it, so the only question I have is, how long will it last? Hopefully it lasts me quite a while. But we'll see. I also got one of the recommended carrying cases for it, but that's another review for another time. Overall Rating: 4.5/5 stars.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought this for my husband for Father's Day.  He was overdue for an upgraded chromebook.  After researching and comparing, I chose this device.  I ordered it on June 3rd, it arrived June 9th and I set it up today, June 11th.  I was feeling good about this purchase, and was pleased with my decision, until I tried to access the camera, one of the features that attracted me, it was an included app.  I could Not get the "Mirror Preview" to turn off.  I didn't want selfies, I wanted pictures.  I spent nearly 1 1/2 hours online with support, with no resolution.  As it turns out, my Issue falls under the category of SOFTWARE, NOT HARDWARE, which conveniently is NOT covered by WARRANTY or INSURANCE.  I am sorry, but I am having difficulty accepting that rationale due to the fact that item purchased and described ( camera) was not 100% operational, but was, rather, defective due to the fact that it did accommodate all of my required parameters for choosing this device.  But ultimately, and herein lies the real kicker:  I can have this issue addressed and possibly fixed by "purchasing" a "service upgrade" entitling me to 1(one) 30 day Single Incident - Lenova Live Assistant - Set-up.  Part #5WS1J63373.  Oh, but that's not all, I get this for a mere $69.00, with an ISSUE DATE of June11 and an EXPIRATION DATE of June 25th.  What does this even mean?  I either have to accept or decline (or just let it go).  Will this option be availabe later?  Will it cost me more?  Welcome to the life of a consumer.  I just tell myself:  The fact that it makes no sense, makes all the sense in today's world.  So far, I love this device, itself

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Ive had this computer for less than a week, so I can't really give a fair rating yet, thus the 4 stars. It came with 2 SD cards for extra storage, a muliti port usb adapter and earphones,  which I will likely never use. The only negative I would give it so far is that the keyboard is the same color as the computer, and the letters/numbers/symbols are also a lighter shade of black. And, the keyboard is not backlit. aPlusContent.rawText:
From the manufacturer
Dell 16 Laptop 

Compact 16-inch laptop with a modern design and Intel Core processors and graphics that power effortless productivity and captivating entertainment. 
16.0-inch 16:10 2K (1920x1200) Touch 300nits WVA/IPS Display with ComfortView
Intel Core 7 150U Processor (10 cores, up to 5.4 GHz)
Intel Graphics
1TB M.2 PCIe NVMe Solid State Drive
16GB, 1 x 16GB, DDR5, 5200 MT/s Memory
Windows 11 brings you closer to what you love 

Family, friends, obsessions, music, creations - Windows 11 is the one place for it all. With a fresh feel and tools that make it easier to be efficient, it has what you need for whatever’s next. 
Edge-to-edge clarity 
Enjoy crisp, expansive visuals on a 16" screen with 2K, and a 16:10 aspect ratio - delivering a wide, immersive viewing experience. 
Ready for business 

Flip between effortless productivity and captivating entertainment on a large, immersive screen powered by Intel Core processors and graphics. 
Built to last, this laptop features military-grade durability, a hardware security chip to protect sensitive information, a wedge-shaped lock slot, and Dell BIOS software - ideal for small businesses or passion projects. 
Built for virtual connection 

Bring your connections to life with an FHD camera, designed with wide dynamic range and temporal noise reduction to deliver crisp, sharp images, no matter the lighting conditions. 
Ensure your voice is captured with clarity and precision using built-in dual microphones, effectively reducing background noise for flawless sound quality. 
And a built-in mechanical privacy shutter for added privacy and peace of mind. 
Inspired by sustainability 

Design innovation: Designed with 50% recycled aluminum in the top cover, and 50% low emission aluminum in the palmrest, with an etched logo on the lid that reduces manufacturing waste and is a more durable design. Thoughtful material and design considerations help lower environmental impact. 
Based on internal analysis, April 2025. 50% recycled aluminum in the top cover and 50% recycled low emission aluminum in the palm rest. 
Elevated standards 

This product is certified ENERGY STAR and registered EPEAT Silver with Climate+. 
Based on internal analysis, April 2025. Based on EPEAT Climate + Designations. EPEAT registered where applicable. EPEAT registration varies by country. 
Packaging innovation 

Ships in 100% recycled or renewable packaging. 
Contains up to 95.7% recycled content and up to 4.6% renewable materials. Renewable materials in the form of sustainably forested materials. Percentages may vary slightly by region[and formfactor]. Excludes optional items added to order and included in box. 
Windows Copilot Key 

With one click, you have instant access to Copilot in Windows – Your own personal AI assistant. Get real answers, inspiration and solutions at your fingertips. 
Timing of Copilot feature delivery and availability varies by market and device. Requires Microsoft account to log in. When Copilot in Windows is not available or enabled on the device, pressing the Copilot key will launch Windows Search. 
All-day comfort 
Dell ComfortView Plus helps reduce harmful blue light emissions while preserving true-to-life color, keeping your eyes comfortable even during prolonged screen time. 
Fingerprint reader 

Fingerprint reader for quick secure sign-in. 
High-capacity battery 

Enjoy long-lasting battery life featuring ExpressCharge that minimizes the time you spend tethered to an outlet, recharging your battery 80% in 60 minutes. 
ExpressCharge must be enabled within Dell Power Manager software. System must be powered off or in hibernation mode for ExpressCharge feature to function. After charging has reached the stated capacity, charging speed will return to normal speed. Recommended for use with the provided Dell power adapter. 
Adaptive thermals 

Built-in technology allows your PC to sense when it's on a stable surface and adjusts its power and thermals to run more efficiently. 
Keyboard 

Full size backlit keyboard with number pad for ease of use and enhanced productivity. 
Ports and Slots 
1. Universal Audio Jack | 2. USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A | 3. Wedge-shaped lock slot | 4. Power jack | 5. HDMI 1.4 | 6. USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A | 7. USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A | 8. USB Type-C with Power Delivery 3.2 (10Gbps) and DisplayPort 1.4

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Impressive laptop with a frustrating setup process
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I just received my Surface Laptop this week. When I started it for the first time I was stuck at the setup because drivers for the keyboard, mouse and touchscreen were not installed. I had to plug in extremal USB KB and mouse to go through setup. The wireless drivers were not installed either so I had to download those onto a USB drive from another computer, then install. After the WIFI was working I was able to connect to Windows update and get drivers for everything else. I work in IT so doing this wasn't terribly difficult for me, but certainly annoying as I haven't had to do that on any new computer in the last 20 years. Surprising for Microsoft's flagship laptop. If you're not familiar with the process it could be confusing.Once setup the laptop has been fantastic. Very fast and the screen looks amazing. So far the battery has been awesome. I ran it for around 12 hours unplugged and there was still plenty of juice left. I may update this review after I've used it for a while to give a more complete review

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Decent Computer/Missing Key itemsDecent Computer/Missing Key items
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I had an Acer computer that was 5 years old and starting to slow down so I decided to get a new one. The original one I had in mind was perfect, but it stated it had a backlit keyboard and after reading several reviews found out it did not, so I decided on this one. This one was just slightly more expensive but it also listed the backlit keyboard, which is necessary as I work in lowlight frequently (and I'm not the best typist so I have to look at the keys a lot!). Shipping was quick, set up took awhile as it needed to download a lot of things and it brought over my personal data from my old laptop, which was a great timesaver. After it was finally up and running I noticed it did not have a backlit keyboard as stated in the description, which was a huge disappointment. I immediately emailed the seller and received an email telling me I could return it and they would notify Amazon to fix the description (it hasn't been fixed yet). As now all my personal data was on the laptop there is no way I was going to return it, which was frustrating as the backlit keyboard was 1 of the 2 key features I was looking for in a laptop. My other is a 10Key/NumPad on the right-hand side of the keyboard. I work with figures a lot, so not having that is a dealbreaker. This laptop has the 10key, but when I went to use it realized they have moved the zero from the spot it was on my last Acer. Ok, annoying, but not something I can't train myself to overcome with a little time. The big thing is there is no DECIMAL POINT on the Numpad. None. How does one key in dollar figures without a decimal point anywhere near the Numpad? There isn't even a comma key where I could change it to a decimal in the Regional settings- there is nothing. If anyone reads this and has any idea how I can make a decimal point, please drop a comment here! All my files are now on this device so I cannot return it without doing a complete factory reset and I'm not 100% confident that removes everything, so I'm stuck with this one for now. The laptop itself works great. The fan is a bit loud, but not horrible. The sound is a bit tinny, but louder than my old Acer, which I could barely hear anything on. The graphics are decent as is the speed. With a few tweaks this would be a solid budget-friendly option. Please add a backlit keyboard and a decimal point to the 10 key. I just can't believe there isn't one there.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The computer itself is great. Not a mark on it! The battery seems to last a long time and charges back up quickly. (2-4 hours) Wi-fi was a breeze and I love the slightly smaller size compared to larger and heavier laptops. You can’t go wrong buying this at this price! Now, all that being said - setup was NOT the piece of cake I was hoping for and it took me down rabbit holes I wish I had never gone down! The first question it asks you is do you want to start from scratch on this computer? Or do you want your laptop to be familiar like your others? We’ll just sync it up to the cloud and boom you’re done. I vacillated. I chose to go cloud. Yeah no. Spent the next 2 days trying to undo and opt out of iCloud. Should have been simple enough. It was not. The ultimate outcome was my HP got ruined in the process with a Critical Error - start menu won’t work. No files on my computer and Microsoft will not support windows 10 anymore so I can’t get a fix. Tried internet fixes to no avail, so now that sits broken in my closet. Bottom line. This is a great computer. Buy it if you get the chance, but put some serious thought as to whether you want to sync it to the cloud or start fresh! I wish I had started fresh!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Con:Whenever the screen is dark, you can see a stain or some kind of damage in the middle. I once encountered an issue where the screen kept turning off & on. In my opinion, the Refurbished-Excellent laptop is not well refurbished. I don't think it warrants a Refurbished-Fair rating because this laptop is not usable with so many issues regarding typing. I type 60 WPM & I feel stuck all the time with homework & the flaw ruins my synergy for studying. I'll probably send it back this week whenever I can find time.Pro:I love its size, it's really cool! Weight is very light. Speed is really good for its size with an 8gb RAM. No issue with wifi. Really sucks it has so much physical damage though. I'm actually surprised it didn't come with foam or bubble wrap to protect it while in transit. I'll make sure to properly protect the computer when I ship it back for its return.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a fair refurbished computer. A couple things to note - if you don’t shut down the computer after using it, the wallpaper tends to disappear into a black screen and it functions poorly. The touch screen is highly responsive, and works well. The battery life lasts for around 4-5 hours, and it connects to wifi well. The computer was not damaged when I received it, and it’s since been fairly damage resistant. It is a chunky keyboard with a smaller than average screen, but that’s okay. The keybord can be flipped completely, and a standard stylus is easy to pair and functions well. The computer is overall solid for the price range, and is easy to use. Just make sure to keep the software updated, and shut it down each time you use it.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Actually NO stars. I ordered this unit to take on some trips - I wanted a durable small lightweight laptop that I didn't need to worry about. Within a few minutes the screen came on - but it was flashing on and off and only half showing. That was the first problem. Then I tried to type - several of the keys were stuck and inoperable. Within 1 hour of receiving the unit, I started my return with Amazon. I boxed it up and took it to UPS with a few days. I asked for replacement unit because I thought that the next one would likely be better... NOT - see that other review too. It came damaged and unusable. I give up. Not sure what I will do now, but obviously these refurbished units (even with a good rating) are not worth buying at all.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Excellent build quality and great for basic computer task.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Long battery life. Good form factor. I know I am in a shrinking minority, but modern the modern windows OS is spyware that harvests the entirety of your digital life and butchers it up for sale (default use of OneDrive - required activation).To avoid that, I installed Linux. The "AI" chips can take a nap until native support comes in later iterations, but the CPU is up to the task. It took a little BIOS tinkering, and after I arm wrestled the partitions away from Window's bit locker, I am left with a secure, fast, and wonderful laptop.Windows deserves -27 stars. But Acer, for the quality of the machine, deserves the full five. It is solid with a tight quiet chassis. The screen is pleasant enough and bright when needs be. The keys are crisp with a pleasant backlight. But the feature I adore most is the battery life. I have had many laptops, and they have all disappointed me in terms of battery life. Yet this has broken the streak of disappointments. Even with aggressive installations and tinkering, it has remained at a healthy percentage for longer than I would have guessed. A pleasant surprise, to be sure.Please know this is not a gaming laptop. I bought this for basic computering tasks and not for ray tracing and online dopamine hits in whatever game is in vogue with spotted teenagers. So if you want a computer for basic computer tasks (word processing, web surfing, multimedia whatnots), this is a solid choice. If you want a laptop for gaming, reconsider. But know this carries my discerning approval.Cheers!

The picture quality is okay. I use my headphones most of his time.What I miss that I wish it had. It doesn’t just wake up when I lift the display. I have to use the power button for it to come on. There is no numbers pad and I like doing a lot of numbers work like using spreadsheets. I find myself trying to use the touchscreen my previous laptop has. I didn’t realize I used it so much.I like it but in hindsight I’d get one with a numbers pad and probably touch screen.  That’s just me though and like I said my husband picked this out and bought it for me.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I love the speed of this laptop. It's sturdy, and it's a handy size for carrying around with you. The battery lasts forever, which is another plus.The only things I don't really like are three of the buttons. The Windows AI button is huge, and it's right between the left arrow and the ALT key. I can't tell you how many times I've hit it by mistake. Next is the Acer button, located between F12 and DEL. I haven't hit it as much as the Win AI, but I've hit it more than necessary. Finally, the power button is on the other side of DEL. It's not a separate button though, it's pretty much just a regular key on the keyboard. Again, not as irritating and in the way as that Win AI button, but it's still another example of poor placement.I miss having a numeric keypad on the side, which I usually used for the page up and page down keys, but I knew that I wasn't getting it when I bought the laptop.Overall, it's a great computer, and if it weren't for those three keys, it would be a five-star product.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Stop thinking about it..Stop thinking about it..
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Very long review in 3.. 2..Apple fan, Windows hater here needing a laptop that was portable and able to handle online coursework, note taking, and personal use (emails, web browsing). I decided to further research and invest in a Chromebook as I have had exposure to it in the past and from the small amount of usage I felt it might work for what I needed. So glad I purchased!I was initially weary about ordering as it's a recertified item. I have heard horror stories about items as such, but felt a glimmer of confidence in Amazon and their ability to send quality items so I pulled the plug. At first look I appreciated how well packaged and cared for the laptop was. There was some smudging that I was able to wipe off and two barely visible hairline scratches, but nothing at all enough to warrant return or to affect its performance.Then I feel a bit doomed.. it wouldn't turn on. Not even upon plugging in the charger would the indicator light on the power switch come on. I instantly thought "here we go", but something told me to just leave it plugged in for a bit; maybe it's been without power for a while? After 30 mins, nothing still. I tried different outlets, changed the power cord from one USB outlet to the other.. nothing. At about 45 mins in I tried the charger on my phone to make sure the charger itself wasn't the culprit and it powered my iPhone right up. I google everything and thankfully I did, as I came across a Reddit post suggesting leaving the charger plugged in and pressing + holding the power button for 30 secs to "reboot" the laptop. IT WORKED! The power button light up orange, then blue. The screen came up shortly after requesting I start the setup process.I got through the instructions then made sure to download any updates before going at use full-force. I have been using my laptop since. There hasn't been any glitching, no lagging. It's smooth despite having a ton of apps and tabs open. All of my Google data came through without issue. Overall, this is a GREAT BUY!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I am not one to write reviews, I'm lazy and don't have time, but having the ability to write and provide a review on a product that is attached to such important aspects of life such as study, is important to me. I am a second year college student attending community college, my academic experience has been primarily carried out online. On a budget, I chose this computer to aid me in that aspect. I am beyond satisfied, I would say this is a great product for the price, but that would be undermining its effectiveness and value, this computer has exceeded my expectations, it does exactly what I needed it to. The touch screen works beautifully, runs effectively for simple tasks, can handle multiple tabs open at once, and allows for multiple variations of screen splitting. I hope this can already be assumed, but due to limited hardware capacities, as a chromebook, you are not gonna extract any type of quality gaming experience from this device, not even for roblox. That being said, delving into my own personal experience with this device in relation to the features I sought out, I specifically wanted a 2 in 1, I wanted to be able to use my computer as an IPad. For my liking, the screen is a tad bit too big to comfortably use as an Ipad, and consequently its also too heavy, there is also an awkward space created between the screen and the keyboard when you utilize the 2 in 1 function. Nevertheless, this does not bother me because its use as a computer is smooth and effective. The camera quality is also below mid, again, not a super big deal for me, but might be for you. Love is a strong word but overall, I love this computer, as I navigate to a higher learning institution, I might outgrow it, but for the moment it supersedes what I want and what I need.  This device has enhanced my academic experience substantially.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: My daughter dropped her macbook in a fit of teenage stupidity, so i got her this chromebook to finish out the year. Initially she was very upset - until she saw and used the machine. It's actually extemely nice - he one we got was basically new and unscratched - i can only imagine they allocate these to schools but return ones that are never used by students.The form factor is great - you can fold it into essentially a tablet. for such a low price it's quite astonishing. It's fast enough too - i watched some youtube videos on it and they loaded sub-second, i played around with a few online apps like google docs and it's very responsive. it's also close in size to my daughter's macbook air - maybe slightly thicker but not by much.All in all i'm extremely happy with it. It solved the problem of ending out the school year without a computer, in an actually very nice way.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Superb build quality but outdated.  Not enough RAM.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This was an amazing deal when I bought it a few years ago.  It has a great keyboard and the screen looks amazing, both better than many full laptops.  The battery life is also very impressive and it weighs very little.  Unfortunately the performance in 2025 isn't good.  The processor is pretty slow and the RAM is a huge problem.  4GB just isn't enough when  a single tab in Chrome often loads more than 1GB of data.  That is ridiculous, but super common now for websites.  If you load the wrong news website it will crash they system.  I LOVE the build quality, but I can't recommend these specs in 2025.  I would definitely look a a newer model in this line that had a lot more RAM.
